sloka: पुनरेव समुद्भूता पद्मे पद्मसमप्रभा ।तस्मादपि पुनः प्राप्ता पूर्ववत्तेन रक्षसा ।। ७.१७.३५ ॥
transliteration: punareva samudbhūtā padme padmasamaprabhā ।tasmādapi punaḥ prāptā pūrvavattena rakṣasā ।। 7.17.35 ॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, she entered the blazing fire, and simultaneously, a divine shower of flowers fell from the sky all around.
